full_name: Angelika Kratzer | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Angelika Kratzer’s area of specialization is semantics, an interdisciplinary field located at the intersection of linguistics, cognitive psychology, logic, and philosophy. Her research concerns how natural languages are constructed so as to make it possible for humans to assemble complex meanings systematically ﻿from small and simple pieces.
